text:
You need a backend developer who can write APIs reliably and fit into your existing workflow.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. For backend-focused work, I’m comfortable designing and implementing API endpoints, working with databases, and keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.

A relevant project was a tutor marketplace MVP for Brightpath Tutors. I built a two-sided marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons, and automatic tutor payouts using Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Stripe Connect, and Twilio Video. The platform went live in 11 weeks and supported 300 tutors, with $48k gross bookings in the first quarter. That project required careful API work around bookings, payments, and user flows.

I also built a clipboard sync browser extension for Clipboardly. It synced saved snippets across devices through a small Express API, using TypeScript, Chrome Extensions API, Express, and MongoDB. The extension reached 9k weekly active users and maintained a 4.7 store rating. That experience strengthened my ability to build lightweight, dependable APIs that support real product usage.

For your backend role, I can help with API writing, database-backed workflows, and integrating the endpoints your team needs. I’m used to building practical systems with REST APIs and working across the stack when needed. While your post mentions PHP, MySQL, AWS, MongoDB, and Firebase, my experience is strongest in Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, so I’d focus on delivering clean backend logic and stable API structure within that environment.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing your current API needs and outlining the endpoint structure before implementation. What is the main API area you need built first?
